# RDPC Services LLC — Taxes for YouTubers, Influencers & Social Media Income

> Tax preparation, quarterly estimated tax planning, and bookkeeping for content creators (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, Patreon, brand deals, affiliate income). Bilingual service (English and Spanish) by Ruben Perez, Tax Advisor, a participant in the IRS Annual Filing Season Program (AFSP).

## Services
- Federal and state tax return preparation with Schedule C for creator income
- Quarterly estimated tax calculations
- Monthly bookkeeping for creators
- Deduction review (equipment, software, home office, travel, contractors)
- Business setup and LLC / S-corp guidance
- Help with IRS letters and unfiled prior-year returns
